purpose: Teach: 敬愛/則っ/基い/準じ/使途/呼び掛け/打ち込み/ベルク

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教員を敬愛する姿勢を保て
lines.en: Ren — maintain respect for your graduate advisor.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Calm authority without harshness. Opens at eye level, lands the point with quiet weight. A senior trusting you to understand the stakes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室規則に則って動きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll follow the lab protocols exactly.
lines.style: Quick, earnest assent. Slight lean-forward in the voice — eager to prove understanding. No hesitation, no defensiveness. The immediate acceptance of someone who respects the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データに基いた仮説を立てろ
lines.en: Ren — build your hypotheses from data, not assumptions.
lines.style: Measured instruction, almost conversational in its authority. The kind of advice that sounds simple until you need it. Delivered with the confidence of someone who's seen what careless hypothesis looks like.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究に準じて手法を選びます
lines.en: Understood. I'll base my methodology on previous studies.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slightly formal register — this is about research rigor. The tone of someone taking notes mentally, absorbing the standard being set.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の使途を厳格に管理しろ
lines.en: Ren — account for every yen of research funding.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. The weight of institutional responsibility in the voice. A senior who knows budgets matter. Delivered with the gravity of someone protecting both the lab and the student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩への呼び掛けも丁寧にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll be careful with how I direct junior researchers too.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly uncertain — he's understanding the breadth of the instruction. Careful tone, thoughtful. The moment of realizing responsibility extends further than he first thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究に打ち込み成果を出せ
lines.en: Ren — commit yourself to the work. Produce results.
lines.style: Quieter than before. The final word carries finality. Less directorial now — more like a quiet belief in what he can do. Delivered at the level of genuine expectation, not pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外のベルク大学とも交流します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also planning an exchange with Berg University overseas.
lines.style: Quiet resolve closing out the conversation. The slight lift on the last phrase — showing initiative, not just compliance. Respectful but not diffident. The tone of someone ready to exceed the minimum.
